answer: Prayers & Duties >> Hajj & Umrah Question ID: 10073 Country: Saudi Arabia Title: i live in saudi arabia.i have bald head,is it advicable to have a wig on my head. if yes, what should i do while doing UMRAH should i remove my hair or i can leave it as such. please advice. Question: i live in saudi arabia.i have bald head,is it advicable to have a wig on my head. if yes, what should i do while doing UMRAH should i remove my hair or i can leave it as such. please advice. Answer ID: 10073 Posted on: Aug 30, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 88/82=B/1429) Instead wig (hairpiece), you should wear cotton or light woollen scarf on head. Pass on razor on head after performing Umrah; it is not lawful to leave it. Also, you will have to put off the wig while performing Umrah. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
